act_title: Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 (Act No. 39 of 1972)
authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

sources.title: Payment of Gratuity and 5-Year Continuous Service Rule
sources.summary: Gratuity is payable to an employee on the termination of employment after rendering continuous service for not less than five years, upon superannuation, retirement/resignation, or death/disablement (where 5-year condition does not apply). Calculated as 15 days wages per year of service.

sources.title: Interest on Delayed Gratuity Payment
sources.summary: If the amount of gratuity is not paid by the employer within 30 days from the date it becomes payable, the employer is liable to pay simple interest at prevailing bank rates.

sources.title: Act to Override Other Enactments and Contracts
sources.summary: The provisions of the Gratuity Act or any rule made thereunder shall have effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent therewith contained in any enactment or in any instrument or contract.
